sources.snippet: The default model is ilo-toki-MiLMMT-46-1b-merged, a fine-tune of Xiaomi's 46-language translation model, quantized to GGUF and executed with llama.cpp. Android and iOS share the UI, the download logic, the view model and the inference core; the platform-specific code is a few dozen lines on each side.
